title: E&I Design Engineer

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in performing sizing calculations, preparing layout drawings, and designing E&I systems for industrial applications. Knowledge of Electrostatic Precipitators (ESP) and Fabric Filters will be considered an added advantage.

title: Mechanical Engineer
minimumQualification: Graduate engineer with a minimum of 70% marks average
jobDescription: The role requires strong experience in mechanical engineering, including handling various mechanical equipment and performing design tasks for EPC, refinery, thermal power, mining, and oil & gas projects. Key responsibilities include technical evaluation, sizing calculations for static and rotary equipment, preparing engineering documentation, managing RFQs and bids, ensuring compliance with industry standards, troubleshooting technical issues, and participating in design reviews. The position also involves project management, scheduling, resource allocation, client/vendor negotiations, and optimizing designs within budget. Strong communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills are essential.

experienceProfile.rawText: 3 - 7 yrs Graduate engineer with a minimum of 70% marks average
